note: One case per rule category (section 9.2). This file is the per-rule test-of-record: check_source must produce exactly the diagnostics a case expects over its source, no more and no fewer. Core conformance (section 9.1) covers the seven construction-time rules HC003, HC006, HC007, HC011, HC-SM01, HC-SM02, HC-SM05; the parse gate HC-SYN holds at every level; HC-P003 is carried as the first structural-rule case. Full and the remaining levels are added as their rules are built (bead honest-framework-4gv).

@link(accepts=accepts_v, emits=emits_v, binds=b)

    return manifest
